Senior React Developer to Rebuild SaaS Analytics Dashboard

Fixed-price - Expert - Est. Budget: $8,500

We are a Series A logistics company and our internal analytics dashboard has
outgrown its original implementation. We need an experienced React developer
to rebuild it against our existing GraphQL API.

Scope:
- Rebuild 14 existing chart views in React 18 + TypeScript
- Replace our hand-rolled state layer with TanStack Query
- Implement CSV/PDF export for every view
- Reach 80% test coverage on the new components

You will work directly with our two backend engineers. Designs are already
finalised in Figma. We have a clear six-week timeline and a defined
acceptance checklist.
